items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Widens UsageResponse + isValidUsagePayload with two optional fields, relabels LeadCard's consumed-spend stat away from 'budget', adds the subagent-spend-gap note and the no-data/partial/complete distinction — matches FR-04.30's display-half AC (a)-(f) exactly, no extra scope (leadwright, budget.usd, claim reorder untouched).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: usageCore's existing try/catch for ENOENT/read/parse errors is unchanged; the two new fields are validated inside the same isValidUsagePayload gate, so a malformed new field still 502s exactly like a malformed core field.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new user input path — leadId is still validated via LEAD_ID_RE before any filesystem access (unchanged). No secrets, no HTML/SQL injection surface.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Every new behavior asserts on rendered text / response body (outcomes), not internal state. Each AC has both a happy path (field present, valid) and an error/edge path (field absent, field invalid, value 0).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops, no additional I/O — the same single usage.json read now validates two more optional fields in the same object-property checks.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: LeadCard.tsx crossed 300 lines mid-edit; extracted the three pure usage-display helpers into a new leadUsageDisplay.ts (44 lines) with its own leadUsageDisplay.test.ts (68 lines), bringing LeadCard.tsx back to 262 lines. LeadCard.test.tsx sits at 306 lines (6 over the guideline) — flagged, not split, since splitting a single component's test file for 6 lines would fragment related AC coverage for no real benefit; noted for the PR.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: leadwright's usage.json writer (external, leadwright#38, out of scope). Consumer: usageCore/isValidUsagePayload -> org-leads-composite.ts -> LeadCard. Round-trip covered by usage.test.ts (write real usage.json to a tmp dir, read back through the real route) for: both new fields present, both absent (backward-compat), each new field individually malformed.
